patterns.note: A dark mode aesthetic with content centered within a constrained width, providing ample negative space around key information.
A deep, dark background is consistently used, subtly accented by a large, soft red/pink gradient that provides visual depth without overwhelming the content.
The background gradient subtly shifts and moves at a slower rate than the foreground content as the user scrolls, creating a gentle parallax effect.
An accordion pattern is used for the FAQ section, allowing users to expand and collapse answers to common questions.
Pricing figures are rendered in an exceptionally large, bold typeface, making them the dominant visual element in their respective sections.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark theme with a deep charcoal background, overlaid with a large, soft, radial gradient in red/pink hues positioned in the upper viewport, which moves at a slower rate than the foreground content to create a subtle parallax scrolling effect.
Key interactive elements, such as pricing cards, use a subtle border and shadow treatment to indicate an active or selected state, providing clear visual feedback.
Content is consistently presented within a fixed-width container, centered on the page, ensuring readability and a structured appearance across various screen sizes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings and extremely oversized pricing figures (~4-5x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards, buttons, and input fields, creating a soft, modern feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive dark mode, combined with a subtle yet impactful red/pink background gradient that parallaxes, creates a sophisticated and modern tech aesthetic. The emphasis on oversized pricing figures also makes the value proposition immediately clear and visually striking.
